name: CNSA Suite for IPsec (RFC 9206)
reference: RFC 9206, Commercial National Security Algorithm (CNSA) Suite Cryptography for Internet Protocol Security (IPsec)
description: High-assurance profile: IKEv2 with AES-256, SHA-384 and ECDH P-384 or DH 3072, and signature authentication.

controls.title: AES-256 encryption
controls.requirement: IKE SA encryption is AES with a 256-bit key.

controls.title: AEAD or SHA-384 integrity
controls.requirement: Integrity is provided by AES-GCM or HMAC-SHA-384.

controls.title: P-384 or DH-3072 key exchange
controls.requirement: Key exchange uses ECDH P-384 (group 20) or MODP-3072 (group 15).

controls.title: AEAD ESP cipher
controls.requirement: ESP uses AES-GCM (key length must be confirmed as 256 on the endpoints).

controls.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy
controls.requirement: Child SAs are rekeyed with a fresh key exchange.

controls.title: No pre-shared keys
controls.requirement: Authentication uses ECDSA P-384 or RSA-3072+ signatures, not pre-shared keys.
